name: [DRIFT ANGLE KIT] Eight Driver Car Racing
desc:
DRIFTING: Turn off Traction Control - make the Drivetrain RWD

🏎️DRAG RACING: Use Performance + Air Induction upgrades to make your car faster

🔧TUNES: Cars drive different based on how you tune your gears and suspension. You can also change parts like Rims, Body kits, Steering Wheels, Camshaft, Intake, Differentials, Flywheels, Exhausts, and more

TO GET MONEY: Race, Police Chase, Drift, Drive around for Money and EXP - Do time trials against yourself for bonuses

❗XBOX, Mobile, and PC Compatible❗
 

EXTRAS: 
⚠️To start a police chase, click a car twice using the Pursuit car
⚠️To rotate your camera while in first person view, right click twice and drag your mouse.
In settings you can turn off crashing, police chases and more.
⚠️Shift + P for Freecam


⚠️You can burnout by accelerating then pressing spacebar
❗JOIN EIGHT STU FOR $2250 EVERY 5 MINUTES
